parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) On the diagram, sketch the graph of y x 2 2 = − for values of x between 3 − and 5. [2]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) Write down the coordinates of the point where the graph crosses the y -axis. (...................... , ......................) [1]

content.tex: Write down the coordinates of the point where the graph crosses the \(y\) -axis.

parts.label: d
parts.text: (d) On the same diagram, sketch the graph of y x 2 1 = + for values of x between 3 − and 5. [2]

content.tex: On the same diagram, sketch the graph of \(y = 2x+1\) for values of \(x\) between \(-3\) and 5.

parts.label: e
parts.text: (e) Find the x -coordinate of each point of intersection of y x 2 2 = − and y x 2 1 = + . ................................ and ................................ [2]

content.tex: Find the \(x\) -coordinate of each point of intersection of \(y = \frac{2}{x-2}\) and \(y = 2x+1\) .
